propositions: Jira workflow constraints forbid direct end-state transitions (e.g. open→done when only open→in_progress→done is allowed), causing outbound sync to fail and tickets to drift.

The replay fallback reconstructs the recorded status hop sequence from append-only STATUS events, re-maps local status names to Jira names, and replays intermediate transitions via the existing transport seam.
Current status is resolved in Jira-name space by fetching the issue and matching against recorded forward-mapped hops without inverting the non-injective LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA map.
Replay aborts and falls through to comment-fallback + drift if any hop raises RuntimeError, ValueError, IllegalTransitionError, or HTTPError; no partial hops are retried.
The local_id parameter is threaded through _update_one_scalar_update from the mutation to enable replay; tracker_dir is self-resolved via reconciler_repo_root() without new signature changes.
